title: #035. Disjunctive Machine Scheduling (disjoint)
subtitle: Schedule steps with release times and precedences across unary tools using disjoint(tasks) to minimize makespan.
caseNames: 7 steps on 2 tools with precedence DAG

judge.m0: Output must be an object { starts, makespan }.
judge.m2: Step {p0} starts at {p1}, before its releaseTime ({p2}).
judge.m3: Precedence violated: step {p0} finishes at {p1}, after step {p2} starts at {p3}.
judge.m4: Tool {p0} has overlapping execution between step {p1} {p3} and step {p2} {p4}.
judge.m5: Reported makespan ({p0}) does not match max completion time ({p1}).
judge.m6: Valid schedule, but makespan ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
